overview.subtitle: Here is what to do next.

ban.title: Your profile is restricted.
ban.body: You can sign in, but bookings and offers are blocked. Contact us if you have questions.

account.title: Account
account.description: Account settings, security, and signed-in devices.

errors.emailTaken: This email address is already in use.
errors.phoneTaken: This number is already in use.
errors.invalidPhone: Enter a number with a country code, for example +49…

toasts.whatsappOn: WhatsApp is on for the messages below. You can turn individual ones off.

toasts.deviceSignOutFailed: Could not sign out that device.

account.noBirthDate: No date of birth on file

contact.title: How we reach you
contact.description: Your account email and phone. This choice is for our concierge, not for automatic messages.
contact.enterEmailCode: Enter the code from the email.
contact.conciergeTitle: How should the concierge reach you?

language.title: Language
language.description: This language applies to the interface, to emails, and to WhatsApp.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose what we write to you about. Everything still shows in the app. Sign-in codes, payments, and support always go to your email.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Personal profile data will be removed. You will not be able to sign in afterwards.
delete.confirmBody: This cannot be undone. Your personal data will be removed and all devices signed out. Booking history stays available for chefs and operations, but is no longer linked to your identity. We will send a code to your email address.

security.title: Sign-in and security
security.passkeysHint: Next time, sign in with Face ID or a fingerprint, without a code.
security.removeBody: You will no longer be able to sign in with this passkey. Other passkeys and sign-in methods stay unchanged.
security.signOutDeviceBody: {device} will be signed out. This device stays signed in.
security.signOutEverywhereBody: All other devices and browsers will be signed out. This device stays signed in.
security.signOutThisBody: You will be signed out on this device and will need to sign in again to access your account.

emailDialog.title: Change email address
emailDialog.description: We will send a confirmation code to the new address.

phoneDialog.hint: Include the country code, for example +49…
